answers.assumption_check: Assumes a console child of a hidden launcher opens no window when the launcher owns an invisible console (CREATE_NO_WINDOW) that descendants inherit; standing as a hypothesis until the proof's tooth 3 reads GetConsoleWindow() == 0 in a grandchild on akiendell. Assumes the Cairn spawn sites, not the harness's own shell spawner, are where most windows come from; unmeasured, which is why the falsifier is a window count over the ground loop and bus. Assumes the 46 unhelped files are mostly spawn sites that should take the flags; some may be interactive on purpose, and the widened scan's red is where each is judged.
answers.builder_check: A Haiku builder would ask: which call names to add to the scan (subprocess.run, call, check_call, check_output beside Popen); what counts as helped (the file mentions detached_kwargs or windowless_kwargs, as now); whether to keep the Popen needle (yes); where the launcher lives (cairn/tools/windowless_spawn/hidden.py, run as pythonw -m cairn.tools.windowless_spawn.hidden <log> <command...>); how it launches (subprocess.run of the argv list, never a shell, with windowless_kwargs, stdout to the log, stderr into stdout) and what it exits with (the child's code); and how the proof reads a window (a child printing ctypes.windll.kernel32.GetConsoleWindow(), run only on nt, a skip elsewhere recorded as not run). The ticket's decisions carry all of it.
answers.children: none, because the sweep of the owning components is cast from the widened scan's own red, one child per component it names, and this ticket builds only the scan and the launcher inside windowless_spawn
answers.collision_check: No collision: it extends the one helper that bce45318b2e0 made (Law 1: one helper replaces hand-built flag sets) and the proof that greps for the bare form (Law 4). The existing proofs assert unhelped_sites over scratch fixtures and over a component's own directory; the build keeps them green. Rule 1 holds because nothing outside windowless_spawn is edited by this ticket.
answers.falsifier_check: Falsifier: clause 1, unhelped_sites names a scratch file that calls subprocess.run, call, check_call or check_output without helper keywords and does not name one that takes them; clause 2, the pythonw launcher runs a command line and returns its exit code with stdout and stderr in the named log; clause 3, on Windows a console child and its grandchild started through the launcher report no console window (GetConsoleWindow() == 0). Horizon: until windowless_spawn.py or the way Windows hands out consoles changes.
answers.gates_bound: proved: red-first proof cairn/tools/windowless_spawn/proofs/test_every_subprocess_site_and_a_hidden_launcher_open_no_window.py, one tooth per falsifier clause; on failure it feeds back to the origin, the 46 files measured without helper keywords (Laws 3, 4 and 8).
answers.missing_check: Not wrapped, and stated: routing scheduled tasks and startup entries through the launcher is a host-seam with its own apply and verify, outside this ticket. Also outside it: the sweep of the owning components (Rule 1, a ticket's build lives inside its own component), which the widened scan's red names one component at a time. The user's further point, pausing the box's background work while he is at it, is a separate intention and is not built here.
